name: FAA SFAR VFR helicopter-tier reserve (20 min)
cite: 14 CFR Part 194, 89 FR 92296 (2024-11-21, eff. 2025-01-21), sec. 194.302(l) -> sec. 91.151(b): 20 minutes at normal cruising speed, GRANTED ONLY IF the AFM shows vertical-landing capability along the entire route; otherwise 30 min day / 45 night
condition_note: the audit applies the 20-min helicopter tier - the tier every audited eVTOL intends to certify for; the vertical-landing condition is assumed satisfied and stated
